newsitem.title: FINLAND: Live Internet cover plan for U.S.-Russia summit.
newsitem.headline: Live Internet cover plan for U.S.-Russia summit.

text.p: Finnish state broadcaster Yleisradio (YLE) said on Wednesday it plans live Internet coverage of next week's U.S.-Russian summit in Helsinki.

YLE said in a statement the service, in Finnish and English, would be available at page http://www.yle.fi/summit/ from March 19 to March 21. It will feature live video and audio of a March 20 news conference by presidents Bill Clinton and Boris Yeltsin.
"The pages employ the latest technology. The Presidents' press conference will be heard and seen on the internet on audio and video," YLE said.
The site is primarily for international media but will be available to all, YLE said.
